flags: OVER-CLAIM RISK: Initial web search summary claimed ISO 27001, FedRamp, PCI DSS, and CSA STAR compliance, but site-specific searches on akkio.com found NO evidence of these certifications. Only SOC 2 Type 2 and HIPAA are publicly documented.

MISSING DPA: Vendor claims GDPR compliance but no Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) are publicly available. This is unusual for a SaaS vendor serving EU customers.

AMBIGUOUS AI TRAINING POSTURE: Privacy policy and terms do not explicitly state whether customer data used in model training/fine-tuning. Terms reference 'Additional Terms' governing AI Platform specifics, but these are not publicly accessible.
NO TRUST CENTER: Unlike comparable SaaS vendors, Akkio has no dedicated trust center or compliance hub—security details are scattered across /security page and FAQ documentation.
DATA TRANSFER TO US: All data transferred to United States for storage and processing; no EU data residency option mentioned.
